scenario.intent: Generate a narrow freestanding herb shelf sized for a window sill, with two side frames, two shallow shelves, a back stop rail, and simple screw assembly.
builder_goals: search existing shelf, rail, rectangular panel, and screw-layout components before proposing anything new
keep the footprint narrow enough for a sill and avoid top-heavy proportions
show shelf panels as flat panels, not long rails
include pilot hole edge-distance guidance and staged assembly visuals

scenario.intent: Generate a wall-mounted charging shelf for cordless tool batteries with a shallow tray, lower cord slot, mounting holes, and conservative electrical safety notes.
builder_goals: reuse wall panel, shallow tray, drill layout, and wall-mount hardware components if available
show where cords exit without requiring electrical modification
include mounting-hole spacing and edge-clearance guidance
avoid claiming the shelf can carry heavy tools unless load validation exists

scenario.intent: Generate a stackable slatted produce crate with open sides, corner posts, bottom slats, hand openings, and nesting/stacking clearance assumptions.
builder_goals: reuse slat, post, rectangular frame, spacing, and overlap-validation components if available
include air gaps between side slats and bottom slats
show a logical assembly order from corner posts to side slats to bottom slats
request a reusable hand-hole or stacking-lip component only if no existing component can represent it

scenario.intent: Generate a monitor riser with a flat top, two side panels, a center divider, open storage cubbies, and an optional rear anti-rack rail.
builder_goals: search for existing bookshelf, shelf, divider, and panel components before proposing a new template
validate clear openings and panel overlaps
show box assembly before divider installation
include a warning that load capacity is not certified without structural validation

scenario.intent: Generate a compact wall-mounted fold-down desk concept with a wall cleat, hinged work surface, side chains or folding brackets, and explicit capability requests if safe hinge geometry cannot be validated.
builder_goals: reuse wall cleat, panel, hinge, bracket, drill-layout, and mounting-hole components if available
do not claim usable load capacity without deterministic structural validation
sequence wall cleat installation before hinge alignment and desk-panel attachment
request missing hinge-motion or load-path validation support if needed

scenario.intent: Generate a wall-mounted folding laundry drying rack with two side frames, parallel dowels, a wall frame, hinges, and a stop chain or brace.
builder_goals: use existing rail, dowel, rectangular frame, hinge, wall-mount, and stage-animation components if available
validate dowel spacing and frame clearances
show dowels installed into one side rail before the second side rail is attached
request missing folding-frame motion support if the existing renderer cannot show the open and closed states

jobs.title: Corner Plant Stand With Stepped Shelves

scenario.intent: Generate a triangular corner plant stand with three stepped shelves, vertical corner posts, rear rails, and conservative anti-tip guidance.
builder_goals: search for rectangular shelf, angled brace, post, rail, and anti-tip/mounting components before proposing new support
avoid intersecting shelves and posts; request overlap-validator enhancements if needed
show each shelf level added in sequence with posts already positioned
do not claim load capacity for heavy planters without deterministic validation

jobs.title: Rolling Miter Saw Stand With Folding Wings

scenario.intent: Generate a rolling miter saw stand concept with a central cabinet bay, caster base, two folding support wings, stop blocks, and explicit escalation for missing structural or hinge validation.
builder_goals: search for rectangular frame bay, caster plate, shelf, hinge, folding wing, stop-block, and dimensioned build-step components
treat this as a concept unless load and tipping validators exist
show the cabinet/base assembly before wings, casters, and stop blocks are installed
request missing reusable components instead of inventing duplicate names for existing frame, caster, or hinge concepts
